messages:
maya: quick heads-up — agenda tweak for today's all-hands in ~10m. moving 'Model rollout Q&A' to the top so we can cover the dedicated pricing question early. also noticed the recording didn't start cleanly on the staging encoder. anyone near the AV stack?

streaming-bot: ERROR: recorder.start failed (timeout). last attempt: 2024-11-15T16:07:02Z. Suggest fallback to Zoom/RTMP.

cj: I got a Zoom fallback ready if needed. creating meeting now — https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (will share in calendar).

irene: quick ask for leadership: can we reserve +10m at the end for follow-ups about roadmap prioritization? I have 3 clarifying Qs re: Dedicated feature timelines.

alex: I'm on AV. if recorder is borked we'll do manual OBS recording + RTMP to the stream. cc: quick obs note:
```
OBS -> Settings -> Output -> Recording path: /tmp/allhands_recording.mp4
Start recording: Ctrl+Alt+R
FFmpeg test stream: ffmpeg -re -i test.mp4 -c copy -f flv rtmp://redwood.stream/live/ah-1805
```

kate: pinged infra to keep a warm GPU node for the demo (won't touch prod). :thumbsup:

ops-bot: canary-demo cluster scaled from 1 -> 2 nodes (request id: scale-4321).

maya: thanks — alex + cj pls coordinate handoff. if streaming-bot still failing, use Zoom as primary and start RTMP as backup. @leadership pls join channel when you can for Qs. :raised_hands: 

cj: Zoom up and posted to calendar. also pasted a temporary RTMP endpoint and creds to alex DM.

alex: confirmed RTMP working locally with a short test: `ffmpeg -re -i sample.mp4 -c copy -f flv rtmp://redwood.stream/live/ah-1805` — streaming to staging now.

irene: prepping my 3 roadmap Qs, prioritizing Dedicated pricing + Private deployment rollout windows. maya I'll DM the order.

maya: (typo note) — meant to say @leadership: please be ready for mic drop Qs about metrics/SLAs. :)

cj: everything green on my side. if recording still fails, we'll ask people to record local demos and upload after the call.

alex: I'll grab a spare laptop to record local backup just in case.

maya: perfect. meeting starts in 7. see you all in the room. final checklist: Zoom fallback up, RTMP test green, leadership on standby. :ok_hand:

ops-bot: Reminder: please avoid pushing large dataset pulls during the all-hands window (16:20-16:50 UTC).

cj: noted. :white_check_mark:

maya: closing thread — will ping here if anything else breaks. thanks team!
